title: Towards Comprehensive Stage-wise Benchmarking of Large Language Models in Fact-Checking

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-as-a-judge evaluation rankings with and without standardized reference guidelines to detect idiosyncratic preferences, specifically measuring the tendency of judge agents (e.g., Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek-V3) to disproportionately assign higher rankings to models from their own model family.
